# wase.download

Self-hosted file conversion. Public pages are static HTML.

- [Formats](https://wase.download/en/formats/): Declared capabilities and tested pages.
- [Machine catalogue](https://wase.download/formats.json): Input-dependent targets; declarations are not guarantees.
- [Developers](https://wase.download/en/developers/): HTTP upload API and read-only MCP.
- [Privacy](https://wase.download/en/privacy/): Files deleted after conversion.

MCP: https://wase.download/api/mcp (list_formats, conversion_info). No remote URL fetching.
Limits: 100 MB per file, 20 files per batch; conversion is queued and resource-limited.
